forum.title: Home page shows new post in thread, but there isn't any
forum.best_answer_content:
@Andrew Neil

It did not take me to that recent post; it took me to a year-old post.

There is an issue in some posts when clicking the name of the latest poster that suppose to open his post but sometimes it goes anywhere in the thread (random behavior).

That issue has been already escalated five days ago.

scraped_replies.html:
Hello ​@Andrew Neil,

As mentioned by ​@mƎALLEm this issue has been escalated, and we’re waiting for a fix. We’ll let you know as soon as it’s resolved.

This happens when you click on the name of the latest poster while the reply is hidden, either because it’s part of a threaded reply or because there are too many replies. In those cases, you’re redirected to a random location. The two attached examples show this behavior.
